scope: Research queue ranks 151–175. Only official venue menus, current in-venue menu images, or clearly current venue tap lists qualify for beerPrices. Delivery, retail, review, stale and unverified crowd-sourced prices are excluded.

venues.name: Zilais Dimants
venues.evidenceNotes: Current address and a recent bartender listing confirm the venue identity, but no accessible current official menu, tap list, or legible current in-venue menu image with beer names, serving volumes, and on-site prices was found. No prices inferred from listings.

venues.name: BABYLON
venues.evidenceNotes: The accessible venue listing provides identity/menu references but no current beer rows with serving volumes and on-site prices. Unrelated Babylon food/restaurant results were not used.

venues.name: Call Me
venues.evidenceNotes: Official Call Me page says its seasonal drinks PDF is kept current when anything changes. The linked official PDF is dated July 2026 and its BEER/CIDER section explicitly shows the beer names, two size columns (330 ml / 400 ml), and prices. The five beer rows above are transcribed from the 330 ml and 400 ml columns; Bauskas sidrs is cider and was excluded.
